TL;DR Can't recommend this game to anybody. Wait for major patch.

The Good

This game manages to faithfully bring back a number of Doom and Doom II features and tidbits, while also coming across as fresh and new. It conveys the "run-and-gun" atmosphere of the original titles, but it doesn't feel like its in a recycled format. It offers great combat, smooth movement, and decent graphics. Overall, its a great deal of fun.

However.

And this is the important part.

The Bad

However, the developer support for the game is poor, at best. There are a great number of users (including YouTube casters!) who are experiencing some very peculiar CTDs and system reboots. These problems do not yield any in-game error messages, nor do they leave a single item in the Windows on-board Event Viewer. The program quite literally kills itself instantly and with no prior notice or predictability, and nobody understands why. The problem has nothing to do with DX, NVidia drivers, hardware, or user-end software, nothing to do with Steam settings, in-game preferences, etc. This is a problem with the program itself, and there's nothing that any user can do about it just yet. And furthermore, this issue hasn't been showing up for most users until they've lodged 10+ hours into the game. At first, it'll seem fine. But when you're in the middle of the solo campaign, â™¥â™¥â™¥â™¥ will hit the fan.

As of yet, the only dev support that anybody has received has been the typical canned response that tells you, "Please download the latest drivers" etc. etc. etc. It just isn't helping. Additionally, some users are reporting that Bethesda and/or ID are trying to hush up this issue by deleting some online forum threads about it, as well as removing negative Steam reviews such as this one.

The Overall

Add this game to your Wishlist, and keep an eye on it. Its a fantastic experience, whether or not you loved the original titles. This game is exactly the Doom experience that the fans have been waiting for.

Just don't buy it until there's a fix for this - rather large - issue of CTDs and reboots. DO YOUR RESEARCH! Look online and check forums and articles, check and see if there's a fix for this issue. And if there's not, don't buy the game. You'd only be wasting money. And if there is a fix...

BUY THIS GAME RTFN!
